basic_profile.bio: A dedicated gamer and trophy hunter from Toronto, Canada. I've been exploring virtual worlds since the early 2000s, and Dark Souls 3 has been my obsession for years now. When I'm not gaming, I'm likely binging the latest Star Wars series or trying to beat my best time in TrackMania. I'm an IT consultant by profession, which gives me the flexibility to game during off-hours, usually late at night. Currently single, I enjoy the freedom it brings to dive deep into games without interruption. My pet cat, Obi, keeps me company during my gaming marathons.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in IT and gaming, largely self-taught through years of hands-on experience and online courses. My expertise in gaming strategies and mechanics comes from thousands of hours spent in various gaming communities, coupled with a natural knack for problem-solving.
